_comment: Reference configuration for the VirusTotal app inside Shuffle. This is documentation, not a file Shuffle reads directly - actual credentials are configured in the Shuffle UI per-workflow and pulled from environment variables.

free_tier_limits.notes: Public API only - no commercial/automated mass-scanning use. Sufficient for a home lab or low-volume SOC automation demo. Add a caching layer before production use to avoid burning quota on repeat IOCs.

endpoints_used.used_by: Playbook 03 - Brute Force, Playbook 04 - Suspicious IP

threat_scoring_thresholds._comment: Used by the 'Calculate Threat Score' step in each playbook - tune these for your environment
